data_check.notes: The script hypotheses precede this numerical check. Williams' 217 rushing yards across three games equal 72.3 per game, only slightly above 69.5; his 47 carries and ARI's 4.42 allowed YPC support a plausible path, not a calibrated projection. Allgeier totaled 74 combined yards across three games, or 24.7 per game, supporting the workload-based under. Both reads survive a competitive-game flip if recent roles persist; Williams is vulnerable to an extreme-blowout rotation. No projection model or simulation was supplied or run. The listed prices imply raw break-even rates of approximately 53.6% for Williams and 53.5% for Allgeier; neither establishes an edge by itself. No stake recommendation without calibrated probabilities.
